    Overview

    Non-Toxic Coating

    Non-Stick Ceramic

    Aluminized Steel Core

    Oven Safe Up to 550°F

    Better baking starts here. Caraway’s Half Bakeware Set is designed to cover all the baking basics, from sweet treats to savory side dishes. Thoughtfully crafted without forever chemicals, our proprietary non-stick ceramic coating offers effortless baking, easy cleanup, and peace of mind at every meal. Complimentary storage completes your set for clutter-free organization.

    Features & Benefits

    • NON-TOXIC COATING: Made without PTFE, PFOA, PFAS, lead, and cadmium.

    • EFFORTLESS NON-STICK: Food slides off for fast, frustration-free cleanup.

    • EVEN HEATING: Aluminized steel core delivers rapid, even heating and durability.

    • OVEN SAFE UP TO 550°F: Designed for every recipe, sweet or savory.

    • EASY TO CLEAN: Wipes clean easily without soaking or scrubbing.

    • STORAGE INCLUDED: Complimentary storage organizers keep your kitchen tidy.

    Non-Toxic Materials

    At Caraway, we are committed to creating high-quality products that are cleaner for your home. Our Ceramic-Coated Bakeware is thoughtfully crafted with an aluminized steel body, non-toxic ceramic coated interior baking surface, and stainless steel handles.

    Our Bakeware is third-party tested, ensuring its cooking surface is made without the following materials. This list is not exhaustive.

    PFAS

    PTFE & PFOA

    Lead & Cadmium

    Plastics

    Care & Cleaning

    1. BEFORE BAKING: Preheat your oven to your desired temperature before adding your Bakeware. Avoid putting empty pans into the oven. Coat with flour or a light amount of oil or butter before food is added, per recipe instructions.

    2. DURING BAKING: Our Bakeware’s aluminized steel core allows for even heat distribution. For your first few uses, closely monitor your heat setting to dial in on the perfect baking temperature or oven time and adjust recipes as needed.

    3. AFTER BAKING: Allow your Bakeware to fully cool before hand washing with warm, soapy water and a non-abrasive sponge. Do not place your pans in the dishwasher, as this will damage the ceramic coating.

    Visit Care & Cleaning for more instructions.
